tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Main background of every page and the app workspace.

tokens.name: bg-subtle
tokens.usage: Alternate landing sections, the sidebar, wells, the footer, input fields at rest.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Grouped lists, the rare card, canvases, focused inputs.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, sheets, popovers, dialogs — always with `shadow-lg`.

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: Secondary (grey) buttons, selected sidebar row, segmented-control track.

tokens.name: fill-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of `fill`.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows, columns and sections; card borders where a border is needed.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on `bg`, `bg-subtle` and `surface` (16.8:1 light).

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text under 21px: metadata, captions, helper text, table headers. 4.9:1 on white; 8.2:1 on black.

tokens.name: ink-tertiary
tokens.usage: The requested secondary grey. 3.6:1 on white — use only for text 21px and larger (the grey half of headlines, eyebrows), placeholders and decorative icons.

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Pure black: primary buttons in light appearance, the phone bezel in product shots.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Pure white: label on primary buttons.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary pill buttons and the citizen's chat bubble. Inverts in dark appearance.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of `primary`.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Label on `primary`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring (3px at 60% opacity, 2px offset) and focused input border. The one non-status use of blue.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Status dot: completed, resolved, online.

tokens.name: green-ink
tokens.usage: Green text and badge label on `green-soft` or white (5.4:1).

tokens.name: green-soft
tokens.usage: Badge ground for completed.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Status dot: active, in progress, working; the live edge in agent graphs.

tokens.name: blue-ink
tokens.usage: Blue text: active labels and inline links (5.6:1).

tokens.name: blue-soft
tokens.usage: Badge ground for active; halo around the current timeline step.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Status dot: pending, registered, needs input, warning.

tokens.name: orange-ink
tokens.usage: Orange text and badge label (5.3:1).

tokens.name: orange-soft
tokens.usage: Badge ground for pending.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Status dot: failed, rejected, offline, critical.

tokens.name: red-ink
tokens.usage: Red text: errors, destructive actions (5.4:1).

tokens.name: red-soft
tokens.usage: Badge ground for errors.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "SF Pro Display", "Inter", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
families.display: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", "Inter", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
families.mono: "SF Mono", ui-monospace, "JetBrains Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Large page titles in the app (Settings-style).

styles.name: title3
styles.usage: Column and group titles, step titles.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Describe the problem in your own words.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Water Board repairs the pipe first.

styles.name: callout
styles.usage: List rows, dense app text, buttons.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Complaint and ticket IDs, skill ids, JSON-RPC methods.

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: Edge labels, node subtitles, raw payloads.

spacing.note: 4px base. Generous: landing sections pad 120px (80 on phones); app content pads 32px.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Text-to-text micro gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label, chip gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: List row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: List row horizontal padding; input padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; gaps in forms.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: App page gutters.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between columns on the landing page.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between app page regions.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between a section head and its content.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Phone section padding; hero top padding.

tokens.name: space-30
tokens.usage: Desktop landing section padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Icon tiles, small controls.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, grouped lists, agent nodes.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, map, vignettes.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Canvases and large media.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pill buttons, chips, badges, search fields.

shadow.note: Almost flat. Grouping comes from whitespace, hairlines and `bg-subtle`, not shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Rarely: a resting element that must lift off `bg-subtle`.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Map pins, floating pills.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Menus, sheets, dialogs, toasts, product shots.

duration.note: Easing cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.1, 0.25, 1). Reduced motion: 0ms, live dots static.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press (scale 0.97).

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Dropdowns, segmented control, row expand.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Sheets and dialogs presenting; section fade-up; page transitions.
